## Load Libraries

```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
import pandas as pd
```

## Step 2: Load and Explore the Dataset

```{python}
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("JobPostingsAnalysis").getOrCreate()

df = spark.read.option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .option("multiLine", "true") \
    .option("escape", "\"") \
    .csv("data/lightcast_job_postings.csv")

df.printSchema()
```

```{python}
pdf = df.toPandas()
pdf.info()
```

```{python}
pdf.head()
```

## Step 3: Data Cleaning

```{python}
pdf = pdf.drop_duplicates()

median_salary_from = pdf['SALARY_FROM'].median()
median_salary_to = pdf['SALARY_TO'].median()
pdf['SALARY_FROM'] = pdf['SALARY_FROM'].fillna(median_salary_from)
pdf['SALARY_TO'] = pdf['SALARY_TO'].fillna(median_salary_to)

pdf['POSTED'] = pd.to_datetime(pdf['POSTED'], errors='coerce')
pdf['EXPIRED'] = pd.to_datetime(pdf['EXPIRED'], errors='coerce')

print("Cleaning complete.")
print(pdf.shape)
```

## Step 4: Exploratory Data Analysis

### Total Job Postings

```{python}
print(f"Total job postings: {len(pdf)}")
```

### Top 5 Job Titles

```{python}
top5 = pdf['TITLE_CLEAN'].value_counts().head(5)
print(top5)
```

### Average Salary by Employment Type

```{python}
avg_salary = pdf.groupby('EMPLOYMENT_TYPE')[['SALARY_FROM','SALARY_TO']].mean().round(2)
print(avg_salary)
```

### State with Most Job Postings

```{python}
top_state = pdf['STATE'].value_counts().head(1)
print(top_state)
```
